verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.brex.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured table of contents. The developer docs are also served as raw markdown pages (.md guides, OpenAPI reference pages, changelog), and an MCP doc page exists, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent docs, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.
